# Qlone, 3D Object Export

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

[Qlone](https://www.qlone.pro/) allows you to scan an object in 3D using your phone. You can directly export a Lens Studio Project within the app and then publish it as a Lens using Lens Studio.

## Export Lens Studio Project[​**](#export-lens-studio-project "Copy to clipboard")

![](/assets/images/qlone-3d-object-export_qlone_guide_screenshot-445797b2f230cb6c3e8a525201d49e5b.png)

Once you finish scanning your item, it's ready for export. Click on the `Lens Studio` export option. This will automatically create a Lens Studio Project based on the [Static Object Template](/lens-studio/examples/lens-examples/static-object.md) with your 3D model. You can select to Airdrop your project to your computer, Save to Files and more.

![](/assets/images/qlone-3d-object-export_3.0-3d-qlone1-bb5bb21692c6dd084bed14a537c8be96.jpg)

After you share your project from Qlone to your computer, you will be able to open it in Lens Studio by double clicking the `lsproj` or by selecting `File -> Open Project...` in Lens Studio's menubar.
